trades.ask: Bring me a Cup Tie Programme and I'll swap you Chapbook: Barnacle Glue for it. I've read it twice and my knees have had enough.
trades.thanks: Lovely. That'll look grand on the sideboard. The pamphlet's yours, mind how you go.

trades.ask: Alright, la, one day I'll stop running out of mackerel. Until then, £150 for Mackerel, just the one.
Listen, la, it's Garden Peas, three of them I'm short of. Help me out and a Wicker Snare is yours.
I'll swap you a Cigarette Card Set for 5 Seaweed. It's been on the mantelpiece long enough.
trades.thanks: Go on then, it's yours. Look after it.

trades.ask: Listen, la, Lancashire Hotpot, just the one, that's my whole wish list. £400 for your trouble.
